rows.name:
Welcome to Acedia! Whether it's
sightseeing or shopping you're
after, Acedia has it all.

rows.label: tlk46300077_02_msg0002
rows.name: But sorrow is not so easy to accept.

rows.label: tlk46300077_02_msg0003
rows.name:
Fan la Norne-sama has passed away...
The goddess with the beautiful
singing voice...

rows.label: tlk46300077_02_msg0004
rows.name:
The whole country is in mourning...
His Holiness Malbeni must be deeply
grieved as well.
